- Completed vendor setup packet (company info, remittance, tax details)

Hi Jared / Marissa,

Thanks for the materials - a few follow-ups from Procurement to keep this moving:

Required items before vendor record completion:
- Completed vendor setup packet (signed) - please confirm the contact who can sign the packet on behalf of Redwood.
- W-9 (received) or W-8 for non-US entities.
- Completed Supplier Security Questionnaire (we can share a link or upload a PDF) - this helps with our internal risk review.
- Certificate of insurance (commercial general liability & cyber) - can you provide a standard cert?
- Banking/ACH details (or instructions for wire transfer) for remittance.

Commercial questions:
- Our default is PO-based procurement routed through Coupa. We can pay via card for smaller POs (<$10k) but prefer PO for committed monthly spend.
- Let us know if you're available to onboard to our vendor portal (procurement@acme-analytics.com will provide portal admin).

Please send the signed packet and certs; if you prefer we can accept an uploaded bundle to our secure portal (link below).

Procurement Portal: https://procurement.acme-analytics.com/vendor-upload

Thanks,
